records.school: Lucille and Jay Chazanoff School of Business
records.evidence: The official Chazanoff School page lists Information Systems and Informatics as a BS program offered jointly by Marketing and Computer Science; its actual academic departments are Accounting & Finance, Economics, Management and Marketing. Imported directory/job label therefore names a program, not an Information Systems and Informatics department. No Operations/Management Science/Industrial Engineering unit inferred.
